preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ,.!?' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Every character in stdin is a lowercase Latin letter, space, or punctuation mark (comma, dot, exclamation mark, question mark).
The text begins and ends with a Latin letter.
The length of the input text is no more than 10000 characters.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' and (i == 0 or stdout[i-1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] == ' ')
postconditions.description: Every space in the output is between two Latin letters (no leading/trailing spaces or spaces before punctuation).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in ' ,.!?' and (i == 0 or stdout[i-1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] == ' ') for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] in ' ,.!?')
postconditions.description: Every punctuation mark in the output has no space before it and exactly one space after it.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' and (i == 0 or stdout[i-1] == ' ') and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ,.!?') for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
postconditions.description: Every Latin letter in the output is part of a word, with no spaces between letters and no spaces before the first letter of a word.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' and (i == 0 or stdout[i-1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] == ' ')
postconditions.description: No two words are separated by more than one space when no punctuation is between them.

postconditions.expression: not any(stdout[i] == ' ' and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] == ' ') for i in range(len(stdout)-1))
postconditions.description: There are no consecutive spaces in the output.
